rules.C2a_primary: One-sided within-task Spearman rho(pi, y), y = a direction's off-default share (catalogue-only, over valid attempts) over the FIRST 10 samples (k 0-1 x W1-W5), averaged over alpha 1 and 2; p from 10,000 shuffles of y. PASS: rho >= 0.4 and p < 0.01 on >= 4 of 6 movable tasks, and the same for pi_masked on >= 3 of 6. DISCONFIRM: rho < 0.2 on most (>= 4 of 6) tasks. Tasks with fewer than 5 directions with y > 0 are flagged underpowered and still count in the primary.
rules.escape_confirmation: Screen pass at N = 10: excess >= 0.20 over the twin (N = 50, k 0-9; others N = 30, k 0-5) and pass >= 0.8 x twin. CONFIRMED if the pooled 30 (k 0-5) keeps excess >= 0.20 with one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 against p0 = (k_twin + 0.5) / (n_twin + 1), and pass >= 0.8 x twin. E_t(alpha) = confirmed / run; MOVABLE := E_t > 0 at alpha <= 2.
rules.decomposition: R_arm = (share_arm - share_twin) / (share_orig - share_twin) on the same CRN slots (k 0-3). 'P_t not needed' if median R_uperp >= 0.7 with bootstrap lower bound >= 0.4; 'Necessary' if R_uperp <= 0.3 (upper bound <= 0.5); 'Sufficient (amplified)' if u_P passes the escape rule at N = 20; otherwise 'mixed'.
rules.C2c: Correct-only Hill-1 >= 1.8 within 5 pass points (of the twin) at 1 x b_t (s = 0.5) on >= 4 of 6 tasks, with nu(0.5) <= 0.5 x the median alpha of this artifact's confirmed escaping random directions. DISCONFIRM: the targeted-minus-random difference in off-default share and in Hill (paired CRN bootstrap) has CI including 0 on >= 4 of 6.
rules.C2b: Pooled within-task Spearman(pi(delta_knob), recorded off-default share) >= 0.5, and pi beats ||delta|| (paired bootstrap of the rho difference > 0).
rules.C3b: Descriptive: push-landing and opening-ladder forecasts scored with exp13 score.py smoothing/log score against the 5 gated iteration-3 bench landings (already seen).
rules.novelty: 'No correct novel algorithm' is claimed only at 0 NOVEL verdicts (rule-of-three bound 3/n).
rules.geometry: Descriptive; persistent H1 vs a 200-draw coordinate-permutation null with a planted-circle power check.
